segments.name: Plasma
segments.description: Provides automated plasma collection devices, disposables and donor management software to plasma collection centers and biopharmaceutical companies.
segments.evidence: "Plasma" includes plasma collection devices and disposables, donor management software and supporting software solutions sold to plasma customers.

segments.name: Blood Center
products: disposables for plasma, red cells and platelets
segments.description: Offers automated blood component collection systems and disposables that help blood centers optimize collections, improve donor safety and control costs.
segments.evidence: "Blood Center" includes blood collection and processing devices and disposables for plasma, red cells and platelets.

segments.name: Hospital
segments.description: Provides interventional technologies and blood management technologies for hospitals and interventional cardiology procedures.
segments.evidence: "Hospital" is comprised of Interventional Technologies, which includes Vascular Closure, Sensor-Guided Technologies and Esophageal Protection product lines, and Blood Management Technologies, which includes Hemostasis Management, Cell Salvage and Transfusion Management product lines.

revenueModel.text: The company earns revenue by selling automated collection devices, related disposables, software and services to plasma collectors, blood centers and hospitals.
revenueModel.evidence: We offer automated blood component systems to blood centers to collect blood products efficiently and cost effectively.

changes.text: In January 2026, the company acquired Vivasure, adding the PerQseal Elite large bore closure system to the Hospital segment.
changes.evidence: The addition of Vivasure expands our Hospital business unit portfolio in the interventional cardiology market and will be included in the Hospital reportable segment.
